Extract the parameter set of a spec

Source: R/spec.R
extract_parameter_set_dials.sim_spec.Rd

The parameter set of the arguments marked tune(), with default ranges from the spec. Change ranges with update(), exactly as in tidymodels, and pass the result to a tuner as param_info.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'sim_spec'
extract_parameter_set_dials(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A simulation spec.

...

Not used.

Value

A dials parameters object.

Examples

spec <- mapping_population(type = "RIL", lines = tune(), generation = tune())
params <- extract_parameter_set_dials(spec)
params
#> Collection of 2 parameters for tuning
#> 
#>  identifier       type    object
#>       lines      lines nparam[+]
#>  generation generation nparam[+]
#> 
update(params, lines = n_lines(c(100, 400)))
#> Collection of 2 parameters for tuning
#> 
#>  identifier       type    object
#>       lines      lines nparam[+]
#>  generation generation nparam[+]
#>
